title: Worker acknowledgement before the first checkbox
description: Read-only proof of a worker acknowledgement. For a model-free actual-marker case, start operation-log-proof-fixture.mjs with WORKER_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_PROOF=1, use operation-log-proof for browser login and worker-ack-cli for the recipe. Select an authenticated gateway profile, FARMSLOT_ACK_PROOF_RUN_ID, FARMSLOT_ACK_PROOF_TAB and FARMSLOT_ACK_PROOF_OUTPUT. Match the run's actual accepted signal attempt to its displayed acknowledgement while checklist completion remains zero.

acknowledgement.intent: The worker acknowledgement appears before checkbox one is completed.
